model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 75 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

facts.label: Name
facts.value: 蔚秀园 (含芳园) Weixiu Yuan

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: held by 醇郡王 奕譞 from 1858, named by Xianfeng (S1216; S1215); no 1860 damage reported

facts.label: Size
facts.value: today's garden way 2.8 ha (run): the pond garden only

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Earlier 定郡王载铨. Malone's sketch: 'Garden of the Seventh Prince, Prince Ch'un', north of 畅春园 across the road. Three ponds and 奕譞's courts on the island survive. Named by 明善 among the nearby gardens (S1207).
